messages:
jane_cust: Hey team — running into a streaming issue with the Python SDK where our generator just... stops. We get partial tokens (e.g. 'th', 'e ') and then the iterator hangs forever. SDK v0.9.2, hosted API. Happens ~5% of requests. No exception in our app, just no more chunks. Anyone seen this?

sophie_support: thanks for flagging — can you paste the exact call you make and any logs around the stream? is this using client.stream() or the low-level SSE helper? Also which model and region?

jane_cust: minimal repro below. No exception, app just blocks on next(token). Using model "gpt-3.5-redwood" in us-west.
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=MY_KEY)
iter = client.responses.stream(model="gpt-3.5-redwood", input="Tell me a short story about a cat.")
for chunk in iter:
    print(chunk.text, end="", flush=True)
# hangs after printing partial token sometimes
```

mike_devx: thanks — that matches an SSE-framing symptom. Do you see any network resets / connection close right after the partial token? Also, are you adding any per-chunk decode logic or touching raw bytes?

jane_cust: no resets in our nginx logs. Connection stays open from their side; client shows no exception and just waits. We didn't handle bytes, using the SDK generator only.

ingrid_engineer: FYI we recently tracked a parsing edge-case where newline-split SSE payloads could leave a partial UTF-8 sequence and the generator would block waiting for completion. It was fixed in the 0.10.1 patch (SSE reassembly + timeout). Could you try upgrading to 0.10.1?

sophie_support: if you can't upgrade right away, try the quick workaround: set REDWOOD_SSE_REASSEMBLE=true in your env or wrap the iterator with a small read timeout in your app. That forces the client to reassemble split chunks instead of blocking on generator.

jane_cust: trying upgrade now. Any quick command?

mike_devx: pip install --upgrade redwood-sdk==0.10.1 — note there were breaking changes in the responses API; your simple stream call should still work but check for a different Event object shape (most code will be compatible).

(just after upgrade)

jane_cust: upgraded to 0.10.1 and ran 200 streams, no hangs so far. Will run longer. Thanks, huge relief.

ingrid_engineer: great — we're going to push an additional safeguard in the runtime to avoid stalls for partial tokens when the server keeps the connection open but pauses. Patch routed to infra, will deploy in next maintenance window. PR: internal/infra#4583 (contains logs and testcases).

sophie_support: if it recurs after upgrade let us know timestamps and if possible a tcpdump of a failing stream. Also we can enable extra debug on your account to log SSE frame boundaries (requires opt-in).

deploy-bot: deploy queued: infra/sse-reassembly-fix -> staging (job 21345). ETA ~15m.

jane_cust: confirmed fixed in prod after the upgrade + deployment. No hangs in 24h smoke. Appreciate the quick turnaround :thumbsup:

mike_devx: followup note for docs: add FAQ entry about partial-token hangs + upgrade to 0.10.1 and mention REDWOOD_SSE_REASSEMBLE env var. I'll create the doc. :memo:

sophie_support: closing this thread unless we hear otherwise. Thanks all!
